answer_1.quote: This paper attempts to introduce some order and clarity into this situation. We make use of a large, new human evaluation dataset, ToShip23, to compare the score ranges of metrics on a large number of systems against pairwise system-level accuracy.
models: various machine translation systems including state-of-the-art models

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the most frequently used metrics in machine translation: BLEU, ChrF, sp-BLEU, BLEURT, COMET.

answer_4.quote: We make use of a large, new human evaluation dataset, ToShip23, to compare the score ranges of metrics on a large number of systems against pairwise system-level accuracy. We only use MQM and DA+SQM subset of human evaluated systems.
answer_4.guideline: MQM (Multidimensional Quality Metrics) and DA+SQM (Direct Assessment with Scalar Quality Metric) protocols
